Early Childhood

My first schools and programs in Bloomfield and West Hartford, CT.

The Bloomfield Early Childhood Center

I attended the Bloomfield Early Childhood Center in Bloomfield, CT, when I was very young. I remember it as a drop-off program with a playroom and everyday routines, and it was one of my earliest experiences in a group setting.

Little Tykes Playschool

I attended the Little Tykes Playschool at Hall High School in West Hartford, CT, when I was about 2-3 years old. My time there was around 2006, and it was one of my early experiences in a preschool program.

Kiddie Academy

I went to Kiddie Academy in Bloomfield, CT, when I was about 3-4 years old. My time there included both classroom time and outdoor play in the playground behind the building. Of these early programs, it is the one I remember most clearly.
